final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS manager_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT manager_count, 1.0 * manager_count / SUM(manager_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.manager_count) AS total_managers, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - t.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE s.share > t.average_share
